THIES is used by unrelated current manufacturers, including textile-machinery and meteorological-instrument companies. The repository record has no legal-name, product-scope or geography discriminator needed to choose one identity safely.

TIEFENBACH does not resolve to one current manufacturer safely. Accessible official results include Tiefenbach Control Systems and Tiefenbach Wasserhydraulik, while the repository record provides no product or legal-entity discriminator.
No current manufacturer-owned HTTPS source establishing the exact TOCINA identity and industrial product scope could be found. Distributor and directory references were not accepted.

TOHTSU TOYO could not be resolved to one current manufacturer-owned identity. Search results mix different TOYO and TOHATSU businesses, and the combined repository name lacks a legal-name or product discriminator.

TORIN is shared by unrelated current industrial brands, including air-moving equipment and lifting-tool businesses. The bare repository record does not establish which company or product scope is intended.

TORK is used by unrelated current brands in industrial automation and professional hygiene. The repository record has no product, legal-name or geography discriminator, so selecting an official source would create a material wrong-company risk.

The apparent current successor site for the historical TOS Rakovnik identity presents an invalid self-signed TLS certificate. The HTTPS source could not be validated safely, and no secondary source was substituted.

TRANSCON is a generic company name used by multiple unrelated manufacturers and engineering businesses. The repository record lacks the product or legal-entity context required to assign the Transcon Conveyor identity or another company safely.

TRIANGLE is shared by numerous current industrial companies and brands. Although an official bearing-manufacturer site exists, the repository record has no product or legal-name discriminator proving that it represents Triangle Manufacturing Company.

TRIBOTEC identifies distinct current manufacturers: a Czech lubrication-systems company and a Swedish corrosion-protection and specialty-chemicals company. The repository record provides no geography or product discriminator.

TRIMEC is used by unrelated current industrial brands, including electric-locking products and liquid-flow measurement equipment. The record contains no product or corporate discriminator needed to select one source safely.

profiles.shortDescription: Texsteam is a Dresser Utility Solutions brand for chemical-injection pumping equipment. The official range includes electric, gas, pneumatic, beam-driven and solar pumps for metering chemicals into industrial processes.
fullDescription: Dresser Utility Solutions' official chemical-injection pages establish Texsteam as a current pump brand within the group.
The documented portfolio covers multiple drive arrangements and metering capacities for chemical-treatment duties in oil, gas and process installations.

profiles.shortDescription: TGW develops automated intralogistics systems for warehouses and distribution operations. Its official portfolio includes storage and retrieval equipment, conveyor and sorting technology, robotics and warehouse software.
fullDescription: TGW's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the group identity and its specialization in automated material flow.
The documented range combines mechanical handling systems, robotic workstations and software used to store, move, sequence and prepare goods inside logistics facilities.

profiles.shortDescription: Thermo Electric manufactures temperature-sensing and measurement equipment. Its official product range includes thermocouples, resistance temperature detectors, surface and wafer sensors, transmitters and related accessories.
fullDescription: Thermo Electric's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the company identity and its focus on industrial temperature measurement.
The documented portfolio combines sensor elements and assemblies with signal-transmission accessories for monitoring temperature in process, machinery and semiconductor applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Thermobile manufactures mobile climate-control equipment for industrial and commercial work areas. Its official range includes oil-, gas- and electric-fired heaters together with coolers and dehumidifiers.
fullDescription: Thermobile's manufacturer-owned site identifies the Dutch company and documents production of portable temperature and moisture-control equipment since 1958.
The published range supports temporary or local heating, cooling and drying duties in workshops, construction, agriculture and other operating environments.

profiles.shortDescription: Thermodyn develops elastomeric sealing materials and engineered rubber components. Its official site describes material formulation and production capabilities for industrial sealing applications.
fullDescription: Thermodyn's manufacturer-owned company page establishes the corporation and its work with high-performance elastomer compounds.
The documented capabilities support sheets, gaskets, extrusions and other application-specific rubber components where sealing and material compatibility are required.

profiles.shortDescription: Thermon develops process-heating and thermal-maintenance systems for industrial facilities. Its official portfolio includes electric and steam heat tracing, industrial heaters, heated tubing bundles, boilers and temporary power equipment.
fullDescription: Thermon's manufacturer-owned site establishes the current brand and its specialization in controlling process temperature in industrial installations.
The documented range combines heat-tracing cable and controls with heating packages, tubing and power-distribution equipment used for freeze protection, temperature maintenance and process heating.

profiles.shortDescription: THIELE manufactures chain systems and components for lifting, conveying and mining. Its official product range includes round-steel chains, connectors, lifting and lashing assemblies and conveyor-chain equipment.
fullDescription: THIELE's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the German company identity and its specialization in engineered chain systems.
The documented portfolio covers components for overhead lifting, load securing, bulk-material conveying and underground mining applications.

profiles.shortDescription: THIELMANN manufactures stainless-steel containers for industrial storage, transport and processing. Its official catalogue covers intermediate bulk containers, pressure vessels, drums and reusable beverage kegs.
fullDescription: THIELMANN's manufacturer-owned catalogue area establishes the brand's current container portfolio within the IRESTAL Group.
The documented equipment is designed for repeatable handling of liquids and bulk materials, with container formats for process, hazardous-material and beverage applications.

profiles.shortDescription: THK develops linear-motion and machine-component systems. Its official product directory includes LM guides, ball screws, ball splines, bearings, cam followers and electric actuators.
fullDescription: THK's manufacturer-owned product page establishes the Japanese company identity and its specialization in rolling-contact linear motion.
The documented portfolio combines guides, screws, splines, rotary components and integrated actuators used to position and support moving machine elements.

profiles.shortDescription: Micron is a Thomson brand for precision planetary gearheads. The official Thomson product range includes in-line and right-angle gearheads designed for servo and motion-control systems.
fullDescription: Thomson's official gearhead directory establishes Micron as a product brand within the company's motion portfolio.
The documented families provide alternative precision, ratio, frame-size and environmental configurations for adapting servomotor torque and speed in automated machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: Timken manufactures engineered bearings and industrial motion products. Its official portfolio includes roller and ball bearings, power-transmission components, couplings, brakes, lubrication systems and related services.
fullDescription: Timken's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the company identity and its combined bearing and industrial-motion scope.
The documented range supports rotating equipment through bearing systems, mechanical power-transmission components and maintenance technologies used across machinery and process installations.

profiles.shortDescription: Tognella manufactures hydraulic flow-control components. Its official product directory includes cartridge and in-line flow-control valves, check valves and pressure-control devices for fluid-power circuits.
fullDescription: Tognella's manufacturer-owned product page establishes the Italian company identity and its specialization in hydraulic valve technology.
The documented range provides adjustable flow, non-return and pressure functions used to regulate direction and operating conditions in hydraulic systems.

profiles.shortDescription: TOKIMEC is the former corporate name retained in the market for Tokyo Keiki hydraulic equipment. The official successor page documents pumps, motors, valves, cylinders, electronics and hydraulic power units.
fullDescription: Tokyo Keiki's manufacturer-owned hydraulic page explicitly connects the current company with the former TOKIMEC name.
The documented portfolio covers hydraulic power generation, control and actuation components together with electronic controllers and assembled power units for industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: TOMRA develops sensor-based collection and sorting systems. Its official corporate material covers reverse-vending equipment and sorting solutions for food, waste, metals and mined materials.
fullDescription: TOMRA's manufacturer-owned corporate brochure establishes the group identity and its use of sensors, mechanics and software to classify and recover material streams.
The documented solutions include automated collection equipment and sorting machines for recycling, food processing and resource operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Tool-Temp manufactures temperature-control and cooling equipment for industrial processes. Its official range includes water- and oil-operated temperature-control units, chillers and cooling systems.
fullDescription: Tool-Temp's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Swiss company and its specialization in process temperature management since 1973.
The documented systems circulate heat-transfer media or provide chilled water for moulding, machine-tool and other production applications that require controlled thermal conditions.

profiles.shortDescription: TopWorx is an Emerson brand for discrete valve-control and position-sensing equipment. Its official range includes valve controllers, switchboxes, proximity sensors, GO Switch devices and smart valve positioners.
fullDescription: Emerson's official TopWorx brand page establishes the current brand identity and its specialization in monitoring and controlling automated valves.
The documented products combine position feedback, local switching and control functions for on-off valve packages used in industrial processes.

profiles.shortDescription: TorcUP manufactures controlled bolting tools and power units. Its official range includes hydraulic, pneumatic, battery and manual torque wrenches together with hydraulic pumps and accessories.
fullDescription: TorcUP's manufacturer-owned product page establishes the US company identity and its production of industrial torque equipment since 1996.
The documented tools apply controlled torque to large threaded fasteners in assembly and maintenance operations, with alternative drive systems for different work environments.

profiles.shortDescription: Tornos manufactures machine tools for precision part production. Its official portfolio includes Swiss-type automatic lathes, multispindle machines, bar feeders, machining systems and TISIS production software.
fullDescription: Tornos' manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Swiss company identity and its focus on automated turning and machining.
The documented platforms support bar-fed production of small and complex components through single-spindle, multispindle and supporting automation technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Torsion Control Products manufactures torsional vibration and torque-control components for industrial drivetrains. Its official range includes spring couplings, torque limiters and torque-converter clutches.
fullDescription: Torsion Control Products' manufacturer-owned site establishes the brand and its current relationship with PT Tech and Timken.
The documented components manage transient torque, vibration and overload conditions between engines, motors and driven equipment in mobile and stationary machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: TOS Olomouc manufactures knee-type milling machines for general and production machining. Its official range includes universal, toolroom, production and CNC milling configurations.
fullDescription: TOS Olomouc's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Czech company and its current machine-tool production within the TOS VARNSDORF group.
The documented milling-machine range provides manual and numerically controlled configurations for workshops, maintenance operations and component manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: TOS VARNSDORF manufactures horizontal boring and milling machines and machining centres. Its official range includes table-type, floor-type and portal machine configurations for large and complex workpieces.
fullDescription: TOS VARNSDORF's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Czech company identity and its specialization in horizontal machine tools.
The documented portfolio covers boring, milling and multipurpose machining platforms designed for production of large components and demanding geometries.

profiles.shortDescription: TOS ZNOJMO manufactures gear units and mechanical transmission components. Its official portfolio includes worm and helical-bevel gearboxes, chain variators, gears and shafts.
fullDescription: TOS ZNOJMO's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Czech company and its gearbox-production history since 1970.
The documented range combines standard reduction gear units with machined transmission components and special configurations for industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: TOSA develops end-of-line packaging and pallet-handling machinery. Its official range includes stretch wrapping, strapping, protective covering and conveyor systems for unitized loads.
fullDescription: TOSA's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Italian company identity and its work in industrial packaging since 1974.
The documented portfolio combines machines that stabilize and protect pallet loads with handling systems that move them through automated production and logistics lines.

profiles.shortDescription: Toshiba supplies industrial electrical and automation equipment through Toshiba International Corporation. The official range includes motors, adjustable-speed drives, uninterruptible power systems, power electronics and industrial control products.
fullDescription: Toshiba International Corporation's manufacturer-owned site provides official evidence for the Toshiba industrial-equipment identity represented by this profile.
The documented portfolio combines rotating machines, drive systems, power-conversion equipment and controls used in industrial power and motion applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Townsend is a retained equipment brand within JBT Marel's meat-processing portfolio. The official product page documents open-top derinding and skinning machinery for meat-processing lines.
fullDescription: JBT Marel's official equipment portal provides current parent-company evidence for the Townsend identity.
The documented machine removes rind or skin from meat products and belongs to the parent's processing-equipment range; this profile does not infer a wider Townsend portfolio beyond the official page.

profiles.shortDescription: TOX PRESSOTECHNIK develops presses and joining systems for industrial assembly. Its official portfolio includes servo and pneumohydraulic presses, clinching, riveting and punching equipment, drives and process-monitoring components.
fullDescription: TOX PRESSOTECHNIK's manufacturer-owned site establishes the German company and its production-technology scope since 1978.
The documented systems combine force-generation, tooling and monitoring for controlled joining, forming and assembly operations in automated manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: Toyoda is a historical machine-tool brand now presented under JTEKT. The official successor page documents grinding machines, machining centres and automation systems derived from the Toyoda machine-tool business.
fullDescription: JTEKT's official machine-tool page establishes the corporate succession and explains that its manufacturing machines originated under the Toyoda name.
The documented current scope covers grinding, machining and supporting automation technologies used for precision component production.

profiles.shortDescription: TPC Wire & Cable is an Amphenol brand for electrical connectivity in demanding industrial environments. Its official range includes flexible cable, cordsets, connectors, cable assemblies and cable-management products.
fullDescription: TPC's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the current Amphenol brand identity and its harsh-environment connectivity scope.
The documented products route power, control and data through industrial machinery and mobile equipment where abrasion, flexing, chemicals or temperature create demanding service conditions.

profiles.shortDescription: Trackmobile manufactures mobile railcar movers for industrial rail operations. Its official range includes diesel and electric bi-modal machines that travel on both road surfaces and rail tracks.
fullDescription: Trackmobile's manufacturer-owned site establishes the US company identity and its specialization in railcar-moving equipment.
The documented machines couple to railcars and provide controlled movement within plants, terminals and maintenance facilities without requiring a full-size locomotive.

profiles.shortDescription: Tradinco Instruments develops calibration instruments, sensors, test benches and supporting software. Its official range includes Traqc instruments and AutoCal+ solutions for pressure, temperature and electrical calibration workflows.
fullDescription: Tradinco's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Dutch company identity and identifies products developed within its own Traqc range.
The documented portfolio combines portable or bench instruments, sensor interfaces, automated test systems and software used to generate, measure and document calibration conditions.

profiles.shortDescription: Trafag manufactures sensors and instruments for pressure, temperature and gas-density monitoring. Its official portfolio includes transmitters, switches, gauges, thermostats and level-sensing products.
fullDescription: Trafag's manufacturer-owned corporate brochure establishes the Swiss company identity and its specialization in pressure and temperature measurement.
The documented range combines electronic and electromechanical sensing technologies for industrial, mobile, marine, rail and energy applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Tramec manufactures gear units and geared-drive components. Its official range includes bevel-helical, parallel-shaft, shaft-mounted, right-angle, planetary and worm gearboxes together with electric motors.
fullDescription: Tramec's manufacturer-owned company page establishes the Italian business and its power-transmission specialization since 1986.
The documented portfolio provides alternative shaft arrangements and reduction technologies for adapting motor speed and torque in industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: Trane develops commercial heating, ventilation, air-conditioning and building-control systems. Its official product range includes chillers, airside equipment, heat pumps, packaged systems, controls and thermal energy storage.

The documented portfolio combines equipment that generates and distributes heating or cooling with control and storage systems used to manage building thermal performance.

fullDescription: Transfluid's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the Italian company identity and its specialization in transmitting and controlling mechanical power.
The documented portfolio covers torsional connection, controlled engagement, speed adaptation and propulsion functions for industrial and marine drivetrains.

fullDescription: Transmotec's manufacturer-owned site establishes the brand identity and its focus on configurable electric motion products.
The documented range combines rotary and linear drive components with gearing, switching and power accessories for automation, machinery and embedded equipment.

fullDescription: Transtecno's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Italian company identity and its current group relationship.
The documented portfolio combines rotary reduction drives with electromechanical linear-motion products for machinery, automation and mobile equipment.

fullDescription: Travaini Pumps USA's manufacturer-owned site establishes the US company identity and the equipment scope represented by this profile.

fullDescription: Trevisan's manufacturer-owned site establishes the Italian company and its machine-tool activity since 1963.
The documented platforms integrate multiple cutting operations in one setup and support production of valves, flanges and other complex rotational components.
